title: Razor Helpers and Tag Helpers for Orchard Core Themes | Orchard Core
description:
A theme written in Razor needs more than its views can do on their own: loading content items, building URLs, converting text, and rendering shapes and resources.

The Orchard helper gives a view extension methods, each module defines the methods of its own features, and tag helpers render shapes, menus and resources as HTML-like elements.

In this video:
• The Orchard property of a view, and the injected IOrchardHelper
• Loading content items by id, alias, slug or handle, and displaying them
• Helpers for culture, URLs, markup and data
• Tag helpers for shapes, menus, zones, resources and media
